label: Motif discovery
purpose: Find short movement patterns shared across tracks
useWhen: Recurring patterns shorter than a whole track
notWhen: No HMM states or track measures yet: run them first
Tracks shorter than the window are skipped
Populations from different segmentations can't share one run

params.requiredMessage: Select at least one tracked population
params.label: Populations
params.tip: Tracked populations from ONE segmentation (motif output columns land on that value_name)

params.label: Window (frames)
params.tip: Sub-track window length passed to STUMPY mstump; motifs of exactly this many frames

params.label: Top K motifs
params.tip: How many best matrix-profile positions to feed into the k-NN + Leiden clustering step

params.label: Target classes
params.tip: Approximate number of motif classes to aim for (hint only, not enforced)

params.label: Lock resolution
params.tip: Freeze Leiden resolution for cross-image comparison (advisory in v1)
